summary: Tuesday's close extended a rates-driven rotation: a firming dollar and 10-year real yields near 3% pushed gold into oversold territory (RSI 24) and hit long-duration bonds hardest, while concentrated mega-cap tech gains kept stocks in greed even as broader equity breadth stayed flat. Crypto cooled slightly from its recent climb but held steadier than the rest.
tweet: Dollar strength and near-3% real yields battered gold and bonds Tuesday while narrow mega-cap tech gains kept stocks in greed despite flat breadth.
